runtime: Perchance engine (browser). No build step, no bundler, no package manager.

internalCode.role: Perchance DSL source - defines the $output(text, exitText, style) plugin function; loads implicitly before index.html runs
Generator HTML = contents of <body> only; documentation page + live $output(...) demo buttons

notes: This generator has ZERO {import:...} dependencies. The '\{import:fullscreen-button-plugin\}' text visible in index.html is ESCAPED documentation copy (a code sample in <pre>), not a real import.
There are no images, audio, models, shaders, animations, JSON data, prefabs, templates, UI resource files, or src/ files in this project.
There is no build pipeline or configuration file - Perchance compiles main.pjs + index.html server-side and injects them into an iframe.
The one external link is an outbound <a href> to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cascading_Style_Sheets (documentation link, not a dependency).
AGENTS.md exists in the workspace but is the AI agent's instruction file, not part of the shipped generator - excluded from this package.
